doc.projectIntro: This quote covers your Microsoft 365 licensing for 20 users, moved onto a Microsoft NCE annual commitment billed monthly, and includes two Microsoft 365 Copilot licences bundled with Business Standard. The Copilot licences are the notable change: you currently license Copilot directly from Microsoft in US dollars, whereas these are bundled and billed in rand — see the note below. All prices exclude VAT (15%).

items.detail: Per-user licence. Full desktop Office apps, 1TB OneDrive, Exchange, Teams and SharePoint. Annual commitment, billed monthly.
Per-user licence. Web and mobile Office apps, Exchange, Teams and SharePoint. Annual commitment, billed monthly.
Per-user licence bundling Microsoft 365 Copilot with a full Business Standard licence — Copilot across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams. Annual commitment, billed monthly in rand.

doc.summaryNote: On the Copilot licences: you currently pay Microsoft directly at USD 36 per user per month for the Copilot add-on alone, on top of your existing Business Standard licences, and that dollar price moves with the exchange rate. The two bundled licences quoted above come in below what you are paying for the Copilot add-on on its own at current exchange rates — and the Business Standard licence is included in that figure rather than billed separately. Billing also moves to rand, so the cost stops shifting with the currency.
terms: This quote is valid until 31 July 2026.
All prices exclude VAT at 15% unless otherwise stated.
Licensing is provided on a Microsoft NCE annual commitment, billed monthly. The 12-month term applies from activation and renews annually unless cancelled before the renewal date.
Licence counts can be increased during the term at the same per-user rate. Reductions take effect at the annual renewal.
Microsoft pricing is subject to OEM (Microsoft) price adjustments.

The comparison to your current Copilot spend is based on Microsoft's USD 36 per user per month list price for the Copilot add-on and prevailing exchange rates; the rand prices quoted here are fixed for the term.
Payment of the monthly licence fee is due in advance.
